title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Admission from Bible Colleges
Accredited Bible Colleges: Admission Policy
Applicants from colleges accredited by the Association for Biblical Higher Education (ABHE), formerly the Accrediting Association of Bible Colleges (AABC), may be granted admission and advanced standing. Two years of study are required for assessment, otherwise high school
transcripts
will be  required for consideration.
A minimum of a B- (70 percent) grade must have been attained in a
course
(s) for transfer credit consideration. Only academic courses will be considered for transfer credit; no credit will be granted for professional courses such as education, administration, pastoral studies, counselling, or courses of a doctrinal nature. Usually not more than 3.0 credits in religious studies will be considered for transfer credit.
Non-Accredited Bible Colleges: Admission
Policy
A
three-year program at a non-accredited Bible College or School may be used for
admission in lieu of the OSSD/OAC requirements at the discretion of the
Admissions department.
